key_facts.fact: Whirlpool Corporation's 2025 Form 10-K includes a formal List of Subsidiaries containing the 113 legal entities named in the answer, with the jurisdiction in which each is organized.

The filing states that Whirlpool reduced its ownership in Whirlpool India to approximately 40% in November 2025; Whirlpool India, Whirlpool China and Beko Europe are discussed as related-party/equity-method investments rather than included in the formal subsidiary list.
